messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the SDK/docs work on tool-calling + structured outputs before next week's roadmap freeze. Can we list the open compatibility gaps?
kevin_eng: main gap is the TS types for `ToolCall` vs current `function_call` payload. TS client has a stricter union that breaks some live customers.
jia_docs: Docs examples currently show both old `function_call` usage and new structured output examples; that's confusing. We should pick a single canonical example for each language.
sam_devex: Agree. Also need a clear changelog entry pattern so migrations are discoverable. Small threads won't cut it.
liz_product: Customer ask: one large partner (healthcare) needs stable structured-output types for JSON schema extraction and won't accept breaking changes mid-quarter. This is a launch gating item.
oleg_runtime: On the runtime side we can keep backward-compat by supporting both keys for 2 releases and emitting a deprecation header in responses. That buys time for SDK rollouts.
kevin_eng: Proposal: (1) Add `tool_calling` as the canonical property in SDKs (v2 surface), (2) keep `function_call` accepted at runtime and map to `tool_calling` server-side, (3) emit X-Deprecation: function_call header until 2 releases after v2.
maria_pm: Sounds reasonable. What about type definitions? We need concrete examples to sync TS/Python teams.
jia_docs: Draft example for TS + Py below — use as canonical in docs. I'll update once we agree.
kevin_eng: TS example (short):
```ts
type ToolArg = { name: string; schema?: Record<string, unknown> }
interface ToolCall {
  tool: string;
  args: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  outputs?: unknown[]; // optional structured outputs
}
// SDK surface: client.toolCall(toolName, args) -> ToolCallResponse
```
jia_docs: Python example:
```py
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List
class ToolCall:
    def __init__(self, tool: str, args: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, outputs: Optional[List[Any]] = None):
        self.tool = tool
        self.args = args
        self.outputs = outputs
# sdk: client.tool_call(name, args) -> ToolCall
```
liz_product: Good, keep examples minimal but show the structured output case where outputs is a list of JSON results.
sam_devex: Changelog policy: add a migration guide + code snippet per language, and a 'compatibility matrix' table in docs that states server mapping behavior and expected dates for deprecation. I can own the matrix.
maria_pm: Action items before EOD Friday: kevin to draft SDK PRs (TS + Py shims) — owner kevin_eng, due Fri COB; jia to consolidate canonical examples and the matrix page — jia_docs, due Fri COB; sam to add changelog template + matrix skeleton — sam_devex, due Fri COB; oleg to add runtime header and mapping — oleg_runtime, due Thu EOD; liz to confirm enterprise partner communication plan — liz_product, due Fri AM.
kevin_eng: I'll open the TS PR and include a `--compat` flag that keeps the old name for one release to ease switchovers.
oleg_runtime: Runtime PR: map `function_call` -> `tool_calling` in request normalization layer, add header `X-Deprecation: function_call (removal ETA 2 releases)` when old key used. Will include tests.
ci-bot: build/ci started for branch `sdk/tool-calling-shim` — test matrix: py3.10, ts-node14, typings-check.
jia_docs: One more thing — rerank + embeddings clients share the same type shapes for `vector_metadata` extraction; we should standardize `structured_output.metadata` shape across those endpoints. Otherwise docs cross-links get messy.
kevin_eng: Agreed — propose `metadata: Record<string, unknown>` and a recommended sub-schema in docs for common fields (source, score, schema_version).
maria_pm: Decision summary: canonical property = `tool_calling` (SDK v2), server accepts legacy `function_call` and maps it, deprecation header until 2 releases after v2. Standardize `structured_output.metadata` shape. Owners + deadlines above.
sam_devex: I'll create the initial compatibility matrix doc and add an examples checklist (TS/py runnable examples + small unit tests).
liz_product: I'll draft partner comms and send to legal for review.
kevin_eng: Quick ask — do we want strict runtime validation of `outputs` JSON schema? That will slow us but gives guarantees.
oleg_runtime: We can make schema validation opt-in per-customer via a flag on their org config. Default = off. That satisfies prod constraints.
jia_docs: OK I'll note that in the compatibility matrix and the examples (show `schema_validation: true` example).
maria_pm: Great. If nobody objects I'll mark this thread as the single source for launch criteria and scope negotiation for this initiative. Please update your PRs/Docs and ping me when done.
kevin_eng: No objections. I'll ping when the TS PR is up.
oleg_runtime: PR in review, ETA Thu EOD.
sam_devex: Matrix started: https://go/internal/devex/tool-calling-compat (draft).
jia_docs: I'll sync examples after kevin's PR lands so types match.
maria_pm: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
